units.source_text: 然而，大竹七段在对弈者的感想中写道：

en.t: However, Otake 7-dan wrote in his comments as one of the players:

units.source_text: 如果黑47下得不稳健，在那里势必给白子留下施展手段的余地，

en.t: If Black 47 had not been played solidly, it would inevitably have left White room to make something happen there,
and that was what he wanted to avoid.

units.source_text: 另外，据吴六段的解说，黑47是好手，是稳健的着法。

en.t: Moreover, according to the commentary by Go 6-dan, Black 47 was a fine move, a solid way to play.
